description: Defines a base class and related structures for OpenMax components, including callback forwarding, event management, and parameter handling, specific to Raspberry Pi 4 platform.

classes.name: OMXParam
classes.description: Template struct for OMX parameter types with predefined size and version.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponentBase
classes.description: Base class for managing OMX components, handling callbacks, events, and parameters.

methods.name: GetInputPortParam
methods.description: Retrieves input port parameters via OMX_GetParameter.

methods.name: GetOutputPortParam
methods.description: Retrieves output port parameters via OMX_GetParameter.

methods.name: WaitForCommandCompletion
methods.description: Waits for OMX command to complete.

methods.name: SendCommandAndWaitForCompletion
methods.description: Sends an OMX command and waits for its completion.

methods.name: OnErrorEvent
methods.description: Virtual method to handle error events.

methods.name: OnOutputSettingChanged
methods.description: Virtual method called when output settings change.

methods.name: OnEmptyBufferDone
methods.description: Virtual method called when an empty buffer is done.

methods.name: OnFillBufferDone
methods.description: Virtual method called when a fill buffer is done.
